title: Laplacian as a sum of flip differences
statement: For every function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ and every point $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, $\Delta f(x)=\sum_{i=1}^n (f(x)-f(x^{(i)}))/2$, where $x^{(i)}$ is obtained by flipping coordinate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: A function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\mathbb R$
